log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Snowbound Taiga. Always cold. Snow can be melted for water if you have fuel.
Somewhere to the south there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A mild year. The cold bites less than it should.
You walk into Ashby. The elder will be at the hall on the north side of the square.
Its people are smiths, and suspicious of strangers. Weapons and armor are cheap here, and there are more of them. Everything costs more, but the elder marks every spring near the town on your map.
Sigrun of Ashby asks for your help: the curse on the land.

town.name: Ashby

stock.artName: Second Wind, Leather Armor of the Phoicae

speech: "Since the black stone stood up in the green knolls, nothing there grows, the water there turns, and the cold there is wrong. Our priests can bless salt enough to break it; take it, and pour it on the stone. Then come back and tell us."
"We do not trust strangers. But nobody should die of thirst: here are the 7 springs near us, and which are foul."
